description: Twelve D045 landscape candidates paired with numbered source photographs for unapproved artwork comparison.
review_notice: This Dasakam 45 chapter is an unapproved reference-versus-candidate artwork comparison for review only. Producer reviews are recorded for all twelve selected landscape candidates; independent exact-checksum review is pending. Photo 003 remains mapped by number/caption to stanza 3 although its picture depicts the stanza-4 mud-cleaning episode; canonical stanza text governs and the mismatch is disclosed. Photos 004–005 are near-duplicate nursing references for stanza 5, not independent coverage. Photos 006–008 and 012 are broad mood references. Captions are verbatim reference commentary, not translations. Portrait production remains paused. Publishing this chapter is not art approval.
visual_review_status: All twelve selected landscape candidates have individual producer reviews bound to final plan SHA-256 cf1cd20791a8fe1176ceb04e1debf49fb4c24592d16d0237791d1920244b0c14; independent exact-checksum review remains pending. rows.scene: After quick movement both children have fallen and risen with mud on their clothes and limbs; two mothers, Rohini and Yashoda, arrive, lift them tenderly, embrace them and kiss them repeatedly. Small heavenly sages smile and worship from above.

The three human warm-brown medians exceed the approximate R−B 120 guide by 26, 14 and 9, respectively, while reading brown in the native view. Independent exact-checksum review pending; not art approval.

rows.candidate_status: Producer review pass after final-plan reinspection v009; exact SHA-256 5f4c72b555b8974501fa4651630add684c70a2bdef549741a63077c5d6766935. No breast is exposed. Krishna’s visible open hand has thumb plus four fingers; both feet are fully concealed under swaddling. Independent exact-checksum review pending; not art approval.

rows.scene: Beside a tree branch, the child points toward the moon and repeatedly asks his mother and father for it as a fruit. As he reaches with both arms, the moon comes into his hands and the scene opens into restrained cosmic radiance around his single child body.
rows.candidate_status: Producer review pass after final-plan reinspection v014; exact SHA-256 efffc90b40fa25e759b4868a6f37b7512af37f61f01e7b7c9b53dc10666a07f4. Skin-only 17x17 median samples: Yashoda (178,103,64), R−B 114; Nandagopan (172,98,60), R−B 112; toddler Krishna (65,90,187), B−R 122. Veil covers Yashoda’s gathered hair; cream headcloth and moustache are present on Nandagopan. Moon disk visibly rests on both palms; enlarged crops show thumb plus four fingers on each hand. Child has one body, two attached arms, five toes on each visible foot and bare forehead. No extra people, text or watermark. Source photo 011 is a broad moon/cosmic reference with a floating child, no parents or branch; the canonical scene follows the stanza and includes both parents and the branch. Independent exact-checksum review pending; not art approval.
